subject: Leadership pulse — prioritization heatcheck & Q2 QBR prep
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-14T08:12:00Z
Subject: Leadership pulse — prioritization heatcheck & Q2 QBR prep

Team — quick weekly check-in ahead of the Q2 QBR. Keeping this short: wins, top risks, and asks with owners and rough due dates. I attached a one-page QBR prep checklist and the April OKR snapshot. Please skim and flag anything missing by EOD.

Wins:
- Acme AI pilot finished throughput validation: 98% of target latency at 95th percentile on dedicated pool. Ops + Eng ready for pilot expansion.
- Two smaller accounts (BrightLane, NovaRetail) converted to Dedicated tier after usage spikes — ($/token up 18% w/ lower support ticket volume).
- Instrumentation rollout: console trace-level cost breakdown now available for 24-hour windows for all routes.

Risks / Issues:
1) Demo week capacity (May 3–7): current Dedicated pools may be saturated if Acme expands to full dataset. Need confirmation from infra whether we can provision temporary burst capacity without breaking SLA for existing Dedicated customers. (Owner: karthik_iyer — ask infra capacity team).
2) QBR deck delta: metrics for model quality regression monitoring are incomplete for one model family (llama-v2-13b variants). Research needs to produce a short readout. (Owner: hannah_schmitt).
3) Procurement for Globex (large enterprise POC) has a late legal redline on data retention — may push start date by ~3 weeks. (Owner: laura_bennett to coordinate with Legal and Procurement).

Asks (clear, small, timeboxed):
- Karthik: confirm burst capacity cost and lead time by Tue 4/20. If yes, outline cost estimate for pilot week.
- Hannah: short note on model-regression gating criteria and expected artifacts for the QBR (due 4/21).
- Laura: update on Globex legal redline and whether we can accept a 90-day retention exception for the pilot (due 4/19).
- All: review QBR_prep_checklist.xlsx and add lane owners in the sheet (link below) by EOD Thu 4/15.

Quick calendar note: I'll run a 30-minute sync Friday 4/16 9:00–9:30 PT to triage any open items and lock the deck. If you can't make it, add notes in the doc.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: QBR_prep_checklist.xlsx, OKR_snapshot_Apr2027.pdf

--
Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-14T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Leadership pulse — prioritization heatcheck & Q2 QBR prep

Thanks Marissa — useful and concise. A couple quick notes: 
- For demo week capacity, we need a fallback plan if burst is not feasible (can we stagger Acme's expanded run to off-peak windows?).
- On the OKR snapshot: engineering accuracy for the latency SLO has drifted in the last two weeks; can Ops/Infra provide a 24-hour snapshot focusing on the two affected routes?

Karthik, can you confirm capacity options and timeline? If burst is expensive, please propose a staggered schedule.

On procurement: Laura -> I'm looping in Legal (via my 1:1) but we should treat any retention exception as time-limited to the pilot and ensure logs masking is in place.

Appreciate the Friday sync; I should be there.

Date: 2027-04-14T11:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Leadership pulse — prioritization heatcheck & Q2 QBR prep

Marissa / Laura — quick capacity update: spoke with infra and finance earlier. Options:
- Short burst (7 days) using existing spare capacity in us-west and preemptible nodes: ~USD 18k estimate; lead time ~72 hours to reserve and configure. Some degradation risk for free-tier customers if we don't micro-isolate.
- Staggered demo window (recommended if we want to avoid cost and risk): Acme runs heavy jobs Mon/Wed/Fri nights (PT) and we serve smaller demo traffic daytime. No extra infra spend, ops support required for scheduling.

I recommend staggered approach unless Sales wants to push for a single-week ramp (Acme explicit ask is for contiguous week). If leadership prefers contiguous week, I can push for the short burst and prepare mitigations (isolate traffic to dedicated subnet + rate limits).

Actionable:
- I will post a short runbook for the staggered plan by tomorrow EOD incl. scheduling windows and ops playbook. (Owner: karthik_iyer — due 2027-04-15T17:00:00Z)
- If leadership approves burst, I need buy-in from Finance for the USD 18k line item by Thu 2027-04-16.

Forwarded for visibility to Acme: Sara, can you confirm whether Acme would accept a staggered demo schedule? If not, we will scope the short burst and provide a cost estimate.
